Messages.Author: Ivan Lerth
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I've a question. Does a press reset the combat to close range even if
in the first round a maneuver were used to set it to long range?.

Thanks,

Messages.Author: dhar...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
Ivan Lerth <ile...@my-dejanews.com> wrote:
> I've a question. Does a press reset the combat to close range even if
> in the first round a maneuver were used to set it to long range?.

Yes. During each round of combat, range is always close unless a
new (and uncanceled) maneuver sets it at long.

Noal
